text:
shout out to all the unemployed or underemployed mf's...both wear on the soul

obviously better to have some job and financial security than none, but still feel like I know tons of guys 40+ trying to raise families who are like...I have a salary, but I feel dead ass fuckin broke

finding "work worth doing" is really rare, dont feel like everyone else has it and you dont. when you talk to ppl you see its all Chesterfield's "coarse pulleys and dirty ropes"

I dont have an answer, having job hunted a lot at a younger age all I know is it sucks ass, time + luck play a huge role, and you just have to keep your spirits high...try and find ways to be helpful to ppl, younger versions of yourself, build shit, create shit, and stay active, bc the physical + mental + emotional are all connected.

same quote as always - "Our nature consists in motion; complete rest is death." Pascal
